name: C#
description: C# is Microsofts flagship language for the .NET ecosystem. It powers Windows applications, game development (Unity), cloud services on Azure, and cross-platform apps. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Official C# Documentation Guide
items.description: The modern living reference book built into the Microsoft ecosystem covering everything from basics to advanced features like records and pattern matching.

items.title: C# Programming Yellow Book (Rob Miles)
items.description: A legendary friendly introductory textbook used in university CS courses. Free PDF download covering programming from first principles.

items.title: C# Language Reference
items.description: The definitive source for C# syntax rules, compiler options, and language specifications from Microsoft.

items.title: .NET API Browser
items.description: The complete reference library for all managed Microsoft namespaces, classes, methods, and structures.

items.title: Microsoft Learn C# Path
items.description: Interactive step-by-step browser modules taking you from absolute beginner to building functional apps.

items.title: Foundational C# with Microsoft (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A guided path in collaboration with Microsoft that culminates in foundational certification.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — C# Course
items.description: Free comprehensive C# tutorials and .NET courses covering everything from basics to ASP.NET Core.

items.title: C# Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive multi-hour video tutorial covering core programming principles to advanced features like LINQ and async/await.

items.title: C# for Beginners (Microsoft Developer)
items.description: Hosted by Scott Hanselman and experts from the .NET team. The official Microsoft beginner series.

items.title: Exercism — C# Track
items.description: 178 free hands-on exercises with automated CLI tests and human mentors who review your idiomatic C# code.

items.title: Codewars — C# Katas
items.description: Community-driven code challenges ranging from beginner to advanced in C#.

items.title: LeetCode — C# Support
items.description: Practice algorithms and data structures using C# for interview preparation.

items.title: Modern C# Cheatsheet (GitHub)
items.description: An exhaustive GitHub repository tracking modern syntax updates including LINQ, pattern matching, and records.

items.title: Zero to Mastery C# Cheat Sheet
items.description: Quick-reference syntax reminders for variables, control flow, and OOP in C#.

items.title: C# Digest
items.description: A weekly curated newsletter featuring handpicked .NET articles, libraries, tutorials, and community highlights.

items.title: Official .NET Blog
items.description: The primary source for new runtime announcements, preview releases, and performance deep dives from Microsoft.

items.title: Reddit r/csharp
items.description: The premier active community for .NET and C# discussions, career advice, and project showcases.

items.title: C# Discord Server
items.description: A massive real-time chat community for troubleshooting code and discussing software design.

items.title: Stack Overflow — C# Tag
items.description: The ultimate archive for troubleshooting bugs, syntax errors, and best practices in C#.
